t: Tzarik lekavven keneged eretz yisrael vedin harokeb o yosheb bispina
s: Tzarik lekavven keneged eretz yisrael vedin harokeb o yosheb bispina ubo y' seipim: bequmo lehitpallel, im haya omed bechutz laaretz — yachazir panayv keneged eretz yisrael, shenneemar: "vehitpalelu eleka derek artzam". Vikavven gam keneged yerushalayim ukeneged hammiqdash ukeneged bet qodshe qadashim. Haya omed beeretz yisrael — yachazir panayv keneged yerushalayim, shenneemar: "vehitpalelu el Hashem derek hair asher bacharta". Vikavven gam keneged bet hammiqdash ukeneged bet qodshe haqqadashim. Haya omed birushalayim — yachazir panayv lammiqdash, shenneemar: "vehitpalelu el habbayit hazzeh". Vikavven gam keneged bet qodshe haqqadashim. Haya omed achore hammiqdash (abal bebet hammiqdash asur laamod bazzeman hazzeh, shekkullam temee metim sheen lanu eper para, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqs"a) bemaarabo shel bet qodshe qadashim — yachazir panayv lammizrach keneged bet qodshe qadashim, shenneemar: vehitpalelu el hammaqom hazzeh". Veim haya omed bitzpono — yachazir panayv laddarom kenegdo. Veim omed bidromo — yachazir panayv latztzapon kenegdo. Nimtzeu kol yisrael mekavvenim libbam lemaqom echad. Veal zeh dareshu chakamim: "kemigdal david tzavvarek banuy letalpiyyot", tel shekkol piyyot ponim bo:

Bimqomot shennohagim lehitpallel leruach mishshear ruchot — al kol panim yetzadded panayv letzad eretz yisrael im hu bechutz laaretz, velirushalayim im hu beeretz yisrael, velammiqdash im hu birushalayim. Veanu machazirin panim lammizrach, mippene sheanu yoshebin bemaarabo shel eretz yisrael, venimtza panenu leeretz yisrael. Velaken qobeim aron haqqodesh bammizrach. Vaapillu qebauhu letzad acher — yitpalelu letzad mizrach. Umikkol maqom, medinot ellu shehen letzad tzapon harbeh ap al pi shehen bemaarabo shel eretz yisrael — lo yiqbeu meqom haaron vetzad hattepilla dehaynu kotel mizrachi keneged emtzait ruach mizrachit shellahem, ella keneged mizrachit deromit (qetzat kepi erek netiyyat nequddat emtza mizrach shellahem mikkeneged yerushalayim, unequdda zo hu meqom yetziat shemesh leir zo bitqupat nisan vetishre haamittit, vehu meqom pegishat galgal mashveh hayyom beopeq ir zeh, shellaken hayyom vehallayla shavim sham bitqupat nisan vetishre). Umaqom zeh bekol medinot ellu hu lehalea minnequddat nokach harosh shel yerushalayim, vetzarik lachashob kamma yihyeh keneged yerushalayim barochab shemmiggalgal mashveh hayyom ad roba iggul shemminnokach harosh shellanu ad meqom pegishat haopeq shellanu bemashveh hayyom, veim rochab zeh shemmeiggul zeh ad mashveh hayyom keneged yerushalayim hu yoter merochab shemmimmashveh hayyom ad nokach harosh shel yerushalayim — tzarik letzadded qetzat ledarom kepi erek yitron hazzeh, veim hu pachot mizzeh — tzarik letzadded letzapon qetzat. Vedabar zeh taluy bemerchaq hammedina miyyam hammaarabi kelappe hammizrach ubeharchaqa mittabbur haaretz kelappe tzapon yoter mimmerchaq yerushalayim. Vecheshbon zeh qal lehayyodeim darke hacheshbon bimshullash kadduri:

Umi sherotzeh leqayyem omram: harotzeh lehachkim yadrim ulehaashir yatzpin — yakol laasot ken apillu betzibbur, ap al pi shehem mitpalelin lemizrach. Umikkol maqom, tzarik letzadded panayv lemizrach keneged eretz yisrael apillu mitpallel beyachid. Veyakol laasot gam behippuk, sheiqqar amidato yihyeh lemizrach, vitzadded panayv ledarom o letzapon kede lehachkim o lehaashir. Vederek zeh yoter nakon keshemmitpallel betzibbur, kede shello yehe nireh kemo shechaluq mehatztzibbur qetzat, shehem omedim lemizrach vehu ledarom o letzapon. Ella im ken shakach veamad letzapon o ledarom vehitchil kebar lehitpallel — azay day lo sheyyahapok panayv lemizrach, velo yaaqor raglayv lahapok amidato lemizrach. Abal im shakach veamad lemaarab — lo yahapok panayv kelal, shehare i epshar lahapok panayv lemizrach veyitpallel, laken en tzarik lahapok panayv kelal, ella im ken rotzeh lehachkim o lehaashir. Veen tzarik laaqor raglayv lahapok amidato lemizrach, lepi sheyyesh min hachakamim shehayu mitpalelim lekattechilla lamaarab mippene shehashshekina bammaarab, veyesh mi shehaya mitpallel leezeh ruach shehaya mizdammen lo, mippene shessober sheshshekina bekol maqom, veyesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad shekkebar hitchil lehitpallel leezo ruach sheen tzarik lehapsiq bitpillato laaqor raglayv velaamod keneged eretz yisrael:
Suma umi sheeno yakol lekavven haruchot lehitpallel keneged eretz yisrael — yekavven libbo leabiv shebbashshamayim, shenneemar: "vehitpalelu el Hashem":

Haya rokeb al hachamor — eno tzarik lered ulehitpallel apillu yesh lo mi sheyyitpos et chamoro, ella mitpallel derek hilluko veyachazir panayv leeretz yisrael im epshar lo. Veken im haya bispina o al gabbe qaron, im yakol laamod — omed, veim lav — yosheb bimqomo umitpallel, veyachazir panayv leeretz yisrael im epshar lo. Veim haya holek beraglayv — mitpallel derek hilluko, ap im en panayv keneged eretz yisrael, vaapillu shello bimqom sakkana, vaapillu holek lidbar hareshut — lo hitzrikuhu lehapsiq halikato velaamod bishat hattepilla, lepi sheyyiqsheh beenayv ichur darko veyittared libbo velo yukal lekavven. Vehakkol lepi hadderek ulepi hammaqom ulepi yirato veyishshub dato. Abal im qadam hu lehashshayyara veyesh lo mi sheyyeechoz et chamoro — yered lematta veyitpallel. Vekol shekken keshemmehallek beraglayv, shetztzarik hu laamod ulehitpallel, shebbaamida zo lo yittared libbo, kevan shemmibbalade ken tzarik hu lehamtin al hashshayyara. Veyesh omerim shebbekol inyan tzarik hu laamod beabot kede lekavven, sheim lo kivven libbo beabot — tzarik hu lachazor ulehitpallel, ukeshemmitpallel derek hilluko — eno yakol lekavven kol kak. Laken tzarik leakkeb habbehema shello tehallek ad sheyyigmor birkat abot, abal en tzarik lered lematta. Verauy lachosh ledibrehem im hu shello bimqom sakkana. Ulekattechilla, lo yetze ladderek mishsheala ammud hashshachar ad sheyyitpallel techilla bebeto kol tepillat y"ch meummad, kemo shennitbaer besiman p"t. Umikkol maqom, im abar veyatza — yakol lehitpallel derek hilluko, apillu mehallek samuk lair betok hattechum, veap al pi sheyyaggia limchoz cheptzo beod sheyyesh adayin shehut harbeh lehitpallel — ap al pi ken yakol lehitpallel badderek miyyad shehiggia zeman hattepilla, veeno mechuyyab lehitakkeb millehitpallel ad sheyyaggia limchoz cheptzo kede lehitpallel sham meummad, shekkevan shekkebar chal alayv chobat hattepilla vehu badderek — yakol latzet yede chobato min haddin baasher hu sham, veeno mechuyyab lehachmitz hammitzva kede lehitpallel meummad, kevan sheakshav hu patur mehaamida. Umikkol maqom, kede leqayyem hammitzva min hammubchar nakon hu sheyyamtin ad sheyyaggia limchoz cheptzo lehitpallel sham meummad, im yadua lo sheyyihyeh lo sham maqom meyuchad shello yebalbeluhu bene habbayit. Veen bazeh mishshum "en machmitzin et hammitzvot" u"zerizim maqdimin lemitzva", kevan shemmitkavven kede leqayyem mitzva min hammubchar:

Haya yosheb bispina o baagala umepached laamod bekol hattepilla umitpallel meyushshab, mikkol maqom yaamod bimqom hakkeriot im epshar lo, kede sheyyehe korea meummad uposea g' pesiot. Veim rokeb al gabbe behema — yachazir habbehema g' pesiot laachoreha veoleh lo keillu posea beatzmo, o yachazir atzmo al gabbe behemto, kederek shehaya noheg im ba lehippater min hammelek:

Zaqen sheeno yakol laamod — yosheb bimqomo umitpallel. Veken choleh. Umitpallel apillu shokeb al tziddo, vehu sheyyakol lekavven dato. Veim i epshar lo lehitpallel bepiv mippene chalishutav — tob sheal kol panim yeharher belibbo, shenneemar: "imru bilbabkem al mishkabkem", veap al pi sheeno yotze yede chobato behirhur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"a. Abal im eno yakol lekavven dato — qore qeriat shema lebaddah im epshar lo, lepi shekkavvanat qeriat shema enah ella pasuq rishon ubeqal yukal lekavven:

Mi shehayu lo nokrim mikkan umikkan umityare shemma yapsiquhu bitpillato o shemma yapsidu miqcho im yaamod veyitpallel — yesheb bimqomo veyitpallel, lepi sheen dato meyushshebet alayv. Veap al pi shetztzarik lipsoa g' pesiot besop hattepilla — yosheb umitpallel vekorea. Yesh lizzaher shello lismok atzmo lekotel o leammud o lachabero bishat tepilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qm"a:
Mi shehukrach lehitpallel meyushshab o mehallek — tob sheyyachazor veyitpallel meummad kesheyyukal betorat nedaba im hu batuach sheyyukal lekavven yapeh bitpillato, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"z:

Mi shebba badderek vehu samuk lemalon shel nokrim, im yakol lehistalleq min hadderek ulehitpallel meummad bemaqom sheqqarob haddabar legamre shello yapsiquhu sham obere derakim — mutab sheyyistalleq veyitpallel sham mishsheyyitpallel bebayit shel nokri shebbevadday yesh bo gillulim vetoebot, veen lehaknis lesham dabar (shebbiqdushsha), shehare mosheh rabbenu alayv hashshalom amar "ketzeti et hair vego'", velo ratza lehitpallel bikrak shel mitzrayim, lepi shehayeta hair melea gillulim. Abal im i epshar lehistalleq min hadderek bemaqom shello yapsiquhu — yitpallel bammalon beezo qeren zaviyyot, shello yebalbeluhu bene habbayit. Veen lachosh legillulim, shehare kol tepillatenu baayarot meleot gillulim. Veim i epshar lehistalleq min hadderek vetzarik lehitpallel mehallek o meyushshab vegam bammalon lo yimtza qeren zaviyyot shello yebalbeluhu — mutab lehitpallel badderek mehallek o meyushshab, kevan sheaz yakol lekavven yoter. Umikkol maqom, im yakol lehitpallel bammalon bebiqa o bechatzer o beginna — mutab, veyetze yede shenehem lehitpallel meummad ubekavvana:
